title: Falsify lexical boundary fix and shadow EVIDENCE_MASS_IGNITION/v1
completion_test_prose: Bind the post-patch live/export source, run the positive/negative lexical boundary matrix plus the existing real-corpus and GWT probes, report false-positive and false-negative deltas, then shadow EVIDENCE_MASS_IGNITION/v1 against fixed MIN_GEDECKT=2 under matched candidates/budget with shuffle, lesion, null/simple-reduction, idempotency and cost controls. Promote nothing unless held-out outcome/support improves without worse null ignition or unsupported citation.
rationale_prose: The current live patch fixes a real German morphology miss but its generic wort[:-2] and unrestricted stamm-in-haystack path risk reintroducing the substring leakage already measured for common words. The current MIN_GEDECKT=2 gate is a sound conservative baseline but may reject a single rare highly informative query token. This task tests both claims without weakening current production gates before evidence exists.
